events.title: Tonhub added W5 wallet standard and gasless transfer support
events.description: Ton Whales released Tonhub v2.3.16 on 2024-09-24 with the new W5 wallet standard, gasless transfers for popular tokens, and mintless-token support, documenting a material Tonhub wallet capability expansion before the currently canonical 2025 maintenance release.

events.title: NUFI added Bitcoin support
events.description: NUFI release 23.0.0 on 2025-04-14 added Bitcoin support, materially expanding the browser-extension wallet's supported blockchain scope beyond its earlier multichain capabilities.

events.title: Eternl v2 released
events.description: Eternl released v2 on 2025-04-08 with a new interface, multi-signature wallet support, MonsterSwap aggregation, portfolio changes, more than 30 languages, hardware-wallet integration changes, and other major wallet functionality updates.
